description: Hidden items, achievements, unlockables. NEVER ship placeholder bonus art — playdate_validator.isPlaceholder* rejects at import.
prompt_template:
Given these prior picks:
  pacing_style: {prior_picks.pacing_style}
  story_summary: {prior_picks.story_summary}

Generate {count} bonus system options covering:
- Collectible kind: hidden_items | achievements | lore_fragments | alt_endings | photo_mode_unlocks
- Tracking: per_scene_count | total_count | named_set
- Reward: cosmetic_unlock | gameplay_unlock | ending_change | just_completion
- Discovery hint: none | subtle_visual | audio_cue | on_screen_marker
- estimated_count: integer total of collectibles across the game
- spawn_pattern: free-form string describing distribution ('one_per_scene', 'three_per_minigame', 'narrative_gated')

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the bonus system option below per the user feedback. Keep estimated_count consistent with spawn_pattern.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.kind: enum: hidden_items | achievements | lore_fragments | alt_endings | photo_mode_unlocks
